Ravi (secops): Flagging P1  discovered telemetry-sidecar v2.3.x making calls to 169.254.169.254 from several staging pods. Potential metadata harvest when sidecars run without network isolation. Need immediate containment.

Taylor (infra): Acknowledged. Spinning up egress firewall to block metadata IP in staging and qa.

Ravi (secops): Repro log (staging):
```
kubectl -n monitoring logs monitor-7fb -c sidecar | tail -n 10
DEBUG curl http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
```

Priya (platform): Rolling patch to telemetry-sidecar:2.4.1 (vendor fix) in 10% increments. Will canary in staging then prod.

Maya (legal): Hold off external customer notices until we have affected-customer list and scope. Preparing template.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-1960 created.

Ravi (secops): Action items: infra apply VPC block (30m), platform deploy 2.4.1 (4h), secops enumerate pods & SAs (2h). Post confirmations here.

Taylor (infra): VPC rule applied in staging/qa.

Priya (platform): Patch at 20% now, no failures.

Ravi (secops): Found 4 pods with metadata hits; quarantined and saved artifacts to /shared/secops/INC-1960. Triage call in 25m.
